about: Fit numbers for the phone_case recipe, read from Apple's Accessory Design Guidelines dimensional drawings (Apple's PDFs in smoothstone-jobs/apple-drawings). Every value has v (mm unless noted) and src (pdf and page). src 'not in drawing' marks a value the drawing does not give; how says what was used instead. Page 1 is the legal page, p2 is sheet 1 (main dimensions), p3 sheet 2 (Camera Control), p4 sheet 3 (camera and sensor keepouts), p5 sheet 4 (antenna and metal keepouts). The drawings say DO NOT SCALE, so nothing here is measured off the picture. Front view: x across from the left edge, y down from the top. Left side = Action and volume buttons; right side = side button and Camera Control. Run tools/phone_devices.py after editing this file.

back_max.how: note 8 on every sheet 1: case thickness on the back at most 2.1 mm

ports_open.how: note 2: do not obstruct ports, speakers or microphones

depth.how: overall thickness without the camera plateau, side view, sheet 1

housing_to_flat.how: Detail B: where the front face turns flat, mm in from the side

points.how: Detail A: [mm in from the side edge, mm down from the top edge] along the plan-view corner. Points are listed from the side tangent to the top tangent.

radius.how: Apple gives no single corner radius; the corner is a continuous-curvature curve given by the points. The recipe draws a Catmull-Rom curve through them. tools/phone_devices.py reports the radius of the circle through the 45 degree point for reference.

front.how: Detail B, profile (all sides): [mm in from the side, mm above mid-thickness]. The front and back profiles differ.

back.how: Detail B: [mm in from the side, mm below mid-thickness, negative]. The front and back profiles differ.
